const { statusMismatch } = await import('@re-cinq/eslint-plugin-re-lint/spec/status-coverage.js');
const spec = \`# Tool Input Validation

| Field  | Value                |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| Issue  | re-cinq/HALEngine#37 |
| Status | In Progress          |

Tool input validation ensures that inputs passed to tool executors conform to the declared JSON Schema.

## Validation rules

- Input is validated before execution ([validated by: test 1](../../src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts#L10)).
- An unlinked statement that is not validated yet.
\`;
console.log(statusMismatch(spec, 'spec'));
"

node -e "
const { statementCoverage, coverageTier, expectedStatus } = await import('@re-cinq/eslint-plugin-re-lint/spec/spec-status-coverage.js');
const spec = \`# Tool Input Validation

| Field  | Value                |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| Issue  | re-cinq/HALEngine#37 |
| Status | In Progress          |

Tool definitions declare a JSON Schema (\`inputSchema\`) describing the arguments the AI model should provide. \`ToolRegistry.execute\` validates the model-provided input against this schema before invoking the executor, returning a rejection \`ToolResponse\` on validation failure so the model can self-correct within the tool loop.

## Schema validation at execution time

- ToolRegistry.execute validates input against the resolved tool definition's inputSchema before calling the executor, and returns a rejection ToolResponse describing the failure without invoking the executor ([validated by: rejects schema-invalid input with a ToolResponse describing the failure without invoking the executor](../../src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts#L18)).
- Validation failure messages name the failing property path and constraint without exposing offending property values ([validated by: rejects wrong-typed input with an error naming the property without exposing values](../../src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts#L36)).
- Valid input including unlisted extra properties passes through to the executor unchanged.
- An unregistered tool name causes execute to throw an unknown tool error rather than returning a rejection ToolResponse.

## Registration and compilation

- Registering a static tool definition with an uncompilable schema throws an error at registration time naming the tool ([validated by: throws at registration time when a static tool declares an uncompilable inputSchema](../../src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts#L54)).
- A static tool definition's schema is compiled once at registration time across multiple calls.
- A dynamic tool definition whose schema differs across calls is validated against the schema returned for that call.
\`;
const cov = statementCoverage(spec);
console.log('Coverage:', cov);
console.log('Tier:', coverageTier(cov.testable, cov.linked));
console.log('Expected status:', expectedStatus(coverageTier(cov.testable, cov.linked)));
"
